subject: Site isolation & maintenance windows — follow-up and requested runbook info
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Tom Lee <tom.lee@geneworks.com>, Karen Alvarez <k.alvarez@geneworks.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Recap + action items — site isolation, credentials & maintenance windows

Hi Tom / Karen —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick written recap and a few follow-ups so we can qualify the private deployment path (VPC / on-prem). High-level: GeneWorks prefers a physically isolated deployment with no outbound internet egress for inference (air-gapped), wants a quarterly firmware/OS update cadence, and expects a narrow weekly maintenance window for reboots/patching. Below are the items we agreed to capture and next steps from our side.

Key notes from call:
- Desired mode: Private (air-gapped appliance in a locked rack on-site) — must allow for KMS-backed key import and no external telemetry.
- Maintenance window: one 4-hour window on Saturdays (UTC-8) or an alternate business-approved slot.
- Firmware/OS updates: target quarterly, with the ability to opt-in to emergency security patches.
- On-call & offline ops: GeneWorks team will perform physical hands-on tasks; Redwood to provide MOPs and signed runbook for escalations.

Action items (Jordan/Redwood):
1) Share our MOP template and an example on-prem hardware inventory template (attached).
2) Confirm exact port/IP restrictions for installation (we asked for the site network diagram).
3) Provide a draft maintenance SLA and recommended rollback plan for kernel/firmware upgrades.

Action items (GeneWorks):
A) Return a completed hardware inventory sheet with rack PDU and switch model numbers.
B) Confirm preferred maintenance window (Saturday 01:00-05:00 local / or alternate).
C) Identify the person(s) who will hold the site credentials and key custodianship.

If this is correct, Ben and I will pull pricing for a Dedicated private appliance + isolated key management and include an ops add-on for 24/7 escalation support.

Thanks,

Jordan Blake
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0124
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-mop-template.pdf (MOP skeleton), onprem-hardware-inventory-sheet.xlsx (inventory template)

From: Tom Lee <tom.lee@geneworks.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Karen Alvarez <k.alvarez@geneworks.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 17:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Recap + action items — site isolation, credentials & maintenance windows

Jordan —

Appreciate the concise recap. A few clarifications from our side:

1) Maintenance window — Saturday 02:00-06:00 PST (UTC-8) works best. We can make an exception for emergency patches outside that window if Redwood triggers it and we pre-approve.

2) Inventory — we'll fill out the hardware sheet. Question on GPU firmware: do you require us to accept vendor-signed firmware only, or can you coordinate a signed rollback image if we need to revert?

3) Credentials — we have an HSM (YubiHSM2) that will be available; our security team prefers KMS material be kept within the HSM and not exported. Is Redwood able to support a KMS integration with customer-side HSM (bring-your-own-key) without key export?

Looping Karen for security notes. We'll aim to return the inventory by EOD Thursday.

Thanks —
Tom
VP IT, GeneWorks Therapeutics
Tom.Lee@geneworks.com | +1 617-555-4491

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Tom Lee <tom.lee@geneworks.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 08:10:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Recap + action items — site isolation, credentials & maintenance windows

Tom —

Quick notes on the two items you called out: firmware rollback & HSM integration.

- Firmware rollback: Redwood's appliance supports vendor-signed firmware only for GPU firmware, but our recommended approach is a staged rollback image kept in a secure S3 (customer & Redwood access controls) for emergency use. For fully air-gapped sites, we can provide a signed rollback image on a USB token shipped under chain-of-custody (supply-on-demand). We will include a MOP step for verification and signature checks.

- HSM/KMS: We support a customer-managed HSM workflow. In the private deployment model we can configure the runtime to call out to the on-site HSM for key operations (sign/decrypt) without exporting key material. We'll need the HSM vendor docs and the admin contact; our security team will run an integration checklist (FIPS modes, firmware compatibility).

Pricing note: adding the ops add-on (24/7 escalation) and air-gap shipping for rollback media is an additional line item. Jordan, can you attach the provisional pricing and the SLA draft to this thread once ready?

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0762

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Tom Lee <tom.lee@geneworks.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 10:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Recap + action items — site isolation, credentials & maintenance windows

Tom —

Thanks — all makes sense. Attached are the MOP template and the inventory sheet (same as I referenced on the call). A couple of additional clarifications so procurement/security have explicit asks they can pass to the facilities team:

- Network: During install we require only these outbound URLs for license verification and telemetry opt-in (can be blocked after install): install.redwood.com:443, kms.redwood.com:443. If you choose completely no-egress we can perform an offline install via USB + signed manifests.
- Spares: recommend 1x spare NVMe and 1x spare GPU power cable onsite for 1-year support; include in the inventory if available.
- MOP acceptance: we'll run a dry-run with your ops lead during the first maintenance window before any firmware changes.

I'll loop in our security engineer if you confirm the HSM vendor (YubiHSM2) — we have a short integration checklist and a one-hour design call we can schedule the week after you return the inventory.

Next steps:
- GeneWorks returns inventory + preferred maintenance window (you indicated Thu EOD for inventory)
- Redwood to send provisional pricing + SLA + integration checklist by EOD Tue
- Schedule a 60m integration call for YubiHSM2 once inventory is submitted

Jordan
